page.layout: One page of text: a chronological table of years (Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriæ, Christi) in six columns, with rules dividing it into three blocks; below the table one starred footnote; signature at the foot right of centre.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ | Christi
main_text.p: * Hoc anno Christi 724 Thoth Nabonasari 1472 transit ad diem bisextilem, feriam quintam.

page.notes: The "Indict." header is printed with a ct ligature ("Indi&."), transcribed as Indict. The Christi entry for the first row, "725/6", is printed with a slash; the first digit group is uncertain and marked by reading only. The "1472" at the start of the second footnote line is printed flush left and may belong to the note's continuation; an odd "¥" mark stands before it and is omitted. The printed arrow sign "→7" beside the first rule of the left column is a pointing mark and is not transcribed. Ruled divisions of the table are not text. Feriæ column for the 6th row of block one reads "6"; all numerals are copied as printed.
